selected_problem: NaturalConversationRuntime must still produce a semantically correct repository change candidate; the existing second-pass needs_more_context path cannot reliably recover unseen files unless the native cognition surface can discover their exact repository paths.

decision_provenance.claim_limit: The hosted Developer Execution Runtime and UPDIA bridge returned transient HTTP 502, so the residual bottleneck family and route are carried by the checked-in DWAC controller/router contract plus fresh canonical evidence; no hosted execution receipt is fabricated.

code_reality: NorthStarRunner already supports a bounded second synthesis pass: proposal.needs_more_context paths are materialized through WorkspaceService.contextBundle and resubmitted to DWAC cognition.

Before this change repositorySummary exposed only file counts, extensions and top-level names; graphSummary exposed only the top semantic nodes. A native synthesizer could therefore know that more context was needed without knowing the exact unseen path to request.

WorkspaceService.contextBundle already enforces workspace path boundaries, text-file filtering, per-file size limits, file-count limits and aggregate byte limits, so the existing recovery path can be reused instead of creating a second read mechanism.
changes: core/repo-context.mjs now emits a deterministic bounded repository path index without reading additional file contents.

repositorySummary now exposes a contextRecovery contract with exactPathHints, truncation/size provenance and an explicit rule to request absent file contents through the existing needs_more_context field rather than guessing unseen code.
The index is capped at 800 paths and approximately 48 KiB of JSON path data, normalizes separators, deduplicates paths and prioritizes existing code/config/test path classes before lexical ordering.
No new code-generation provider, product shape, model dependency or development-mode mapping is introduced.

verification.evidence: path list stops before exceeding configured byte budget and reports truncated=true

truth_boundaries: This cycle improves context recovery for DWAC native synthesis; it does not claim that path discovery by itself makes NaturalConversationRuntime a universal repository code synthesizer.
The path index carries names only, not unseen file contents; actual content is supplied only if DWAC requests an exact path through the existing bounded needs_more_context second pass.
The bounded path index can be truncated on very large repositories; truncation is explicit and is not treated as full repository visibility.
Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED; this change narrows one concrete context-recovery failure mode without fabricating semantic synthesis capability.
The hosted Developer Execution Runtime and UPDIA provider were transiently unavailable with HTTP 502 in this cycle; focused local validation is reported instead and no hosted receipt is claimed.
No GitHub Actions are used for this change set.
